systems.platform: built by Liberia Revenue Authority programmers; reached through the Liberia National Police website, with electronic payment, application tracking, certificate verification and digital fingerprint integration
systems.owner: Liberia National Police, with the Liberia Revenue Authority
systems.tiers: launched at Liberia National Police Headquarters on 1 May 2026; a rollout to five further regions announced, not delivered

note: Only a public clearance portal is described, with a donation of four laptops and two fingerprint machines; nothing on station records.
